sections.html: The large-growing, magnificent Panaque bathyphilus is very variable in coloration. Specimens 16-20 cm long are about half grown, as the maximum length given for P. bathyphilus is about 60 cm.
P. bathyphilus occurs in Peru (surroundings of Tingo Maria).
These large fish should only be kept in large aquariums with strong filtration.

Like all Panaque, P. bathyphilus is predominantly a wood eater. The amount of feces produced by this nutrient-poor diet is enormous, which is another reason why large tanks with strong filtration are necessary.
Among themselves Panaque are not quite without aggression and can become quite rough. However, L90 is considered one of the more tolerant species in this regard.
